hits.title: Ahrefs Changelog: Running List of New Features
hits.snippet: # Ahrefs Changelog: Running List of New Features ### The pace we ship at ![tiktok social media tool](https://ahrefs.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/tiktok-social-media-tool.webp) **29 Aug**: In Keywords Explorer’s Traffic Share reports, a new competitors map visualises who is winning your keywords by traffic and traffic value. **22 Aug**: Brand Radar charts can now be exported directly – send data to Google Sheets or download any chart as CSV for easier sharing and analysis. **22 Aug**: Cited Domains and Cited Pages in Brand Radar now have dedicated filters for domains and URLs, plus Cited Domains shows how many cited pages each domain has to highlight where coverage is concentrated. **19 Aug**: Launched Ahrefs Connect – our new integration layer on API v3 – so third-party tools can access your Ahrefs data via OAuth (competitive intel, Site Audit, organic, backlinks, and more). **19 Aug**: Site Explorer Overview now includes a SERP features history chart that shows how many positions you hold in SERP features over time (owned vs total), with interactive drilldowns into Organic Keywords. **18 Aug**: Rank Tracker and GSC charts now use shared user notes across the whole workspace
